defining_behavior: Telegraphs and performs a straight charge
behavior_kind: persistent giant pursuer with exactly one additional behavior

contact_footprint.appendages_outside_footprint: may pass over the mech harmlessly
contact_footprint.attack_geometry_uses_separate_display: charge lanes, projectile shapes, and landing circles use their separately displayed attack geometry rather than the boss contact circle

damage_pressure.assumptions: 100 Hull, zero Armor, no healing, no resonance, uninterrupted overlap with one attacker

milestone_reach_target_probability.cohort: players who understand movement and fabrication but have no permanent PowerUps

ability.targeting: displays a wide straight charge lane toward the mech's sampled position
ability.lane_validation: the lane never knowingly selects a route that immediately collides with terrain before covering one body length
ability.terrain_interaction: terrain stops the charge without stunning or damaging the boss
ability.miss_consequence: missing carries Riftjaw past the player and creates a brief damage opportunity before pursuit resumes
ability.hit_rule: a dedicated per-ability hit rule rather than the ordinary 18 contact
ability.design_role: checks movement, facing awareness, and early single-target damage without adding projectiles or summons

persistence.spawn_rule: enters from valid navigable ground outside the camera; never on the mech, inside an active mining zone, or in an unavoidable collision path

reentry.trigger: remains far outside the combat area
reentry.behavior: re-enters from a telegraphed valid off-screen approach

resonance.control_resistance_combines_with_driftme: without reaching complete immunity unless a later rule says so

defeat_reward.material_selection: each unit independently selects one of the four materials present in the geological profile, with duplicates allowed and absent materials excluded
defeat_reward.delivery: non-modal physical loot burst scattered onto valid nearby ground, contact-collected, persisting until collected or run end, with an immediate minimap marker

description: Riftjaw is a long burrowing predator with an armored wedge head and a segmented body that remains fully visible above ground during ordinary pursuit.
